reviews.t: Helped formulate my lotion!
reviews.x: In the process of formulating a replacement for a fave lotion that isn't available anymore, the active ingredient wouldn't go into solution with anything I've used before. Then I discovered propylene glycol - it did what jojoba oil, water or glycerin couldn't. Yay! And at 1% by volume it makes absorption of my chosen actives into the skin more efficient too. Yes! 6oz bottle doesn't hog room stored in the fridge either ;)

reviews.t: Very Pleased - Rehydrated Several Cosmetics For Me
reviews.x: Excellent.  Rehydrated a dried up glitter eyeliner and a mascara.  If purchasing, recommend purchasing an eye dropper if you don't already have one.  Used 3 drops for a fairly small eyeliner.  Used 5 for a tall Great Lash mascara.  No odor, no scent.  Consistency of the product also made it easy to use.  It was not thick or oily, like an oil would be.

claims.text: Several customers report receiving bottles that were underfilled or short of the advertised 6oz amount, even without any signs of leakage.
Some reviewers were unhappy with the packaging, describing taped caps and a bottle that arrived leaky and covered in product.
Many customers praise the product's clean taste and effectiveness for vaping and e-juice mixing.
Reviewers find it useful as a carrier or mixing fluid for projects like suspending powders, formulating lotion, and rehydrating cosmetics.
Customers note fast or on-time delivery and consider it a good value for the price.
